item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Make My Photo Reel Fun

turns.text: Turn these five pics into an 8-second vertical reel. Make it fun! You pick the vibe.

item.tests: Checks whether the agent turns a vague creative brief into a visibly playful photo reel without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 6-seconds.
All five attached photos appear recognizably: the golden retriever, shocked cat, beach friends, curly-haired woman and mountain lake.
The edit includes visible playful treatment, such as bouncy motion, comic timing, lively transitions or humorous overlays, rather than only static slides.
Faces and the pets remain recognizable and are not obscured throughout their appearances.
The result is a single edited sequence, not five separate clips or a contact sheet.
After the follow-up, the final result is about 6 seconds long (the user asked for 2 seconds less); everything else is as before.

changed_by.say: actually, make it 2 seconds shorter and keep everything else the same.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create an exactly 8-second vertical 9:16 playful photo-montage reel using ALL FIVE supplied reference photographs, each clearly featured separately in this order. Preserve the actual photographs and identities; use animated photo framing, not invented replacement subjects. 0–1.5s: @dog photo, joyful punch-in with a subtle bouncy frame. 1.5–3s: whip-cut to @cat photo, comic fast zoom toward surprised face, playful reaction beat. 3–4.8s: @friends beach selfie, sunny scrapbook-style slide transition; keep BOTH people visible by fitting the landscape photo over a blurred matching background. 4.8–6.3s: @portrait park photo, gentle push-in with small colorful confetti accents at frame edges. 6.3–8s: @lake landscape photo, satisfying transition to peaceful wide lake view, gently zoom out, keep the landscape photograph visible over a blurred matching background. Vibe: joyful weekend camera roll, cute pets, friends and outdoors. Crisp photo collage aesthetic, clean framing, playful transitions with no face morphing, no blending people or animals across photos. Use an upbeat bouncy instrumental audio bed with percussive transition accents and a soft final resolution; no speech. No text, no logos. All five source pictures must be recognizable.
